title: Grid Carbon Intensity Forecasting

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Grid Carbon Intensity Forecasting": Forecast the carbon intensity of grid electricity by region and hour so flexible loads, charging and reporting use cleaner times and numbers. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Mixing average and marginal intensity.
